title: Long Mott (Dow / X-energy): Proprietary Determination - Construction Permit Application Revision 1 [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:           Adrian Muniz
To:             ext_Mark_Feltner; Stephen Vaughn
Cc:             O"Connor, Charles (CR); Jessica Maddocks; Alissa Neuhausen
Subject:        Long Mott Energy, LLC - Request for Withholding Information from Public Disclosure - Construction Permit
                Application Revision 1
Date:           Tuesday, October 27, 2026 6:34:00 PM


Dear Mr. Feltner and Mr. Vaughn,

By letter dated September 18, 2026 (ML26261A419), you submitted affidavits requesting
that specific information included with the letter be withheld from public disclosure pursuant
to Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10 CFR) Section 2.390. The NRC staff
reviewed the material contained in Revision 1 of the construction permit application
identified in the affidavits in accordance with 10 CFR 2.390 requirements. Based on the
statements in the affidavits, the staff determined that the information sought to be withheld
contains proprietary commercial information and should be withheld from public disclosure.
Therefore, the information marked as proprietary will be withheld from public disclosure
pursuant to 10 CFR 2.390(b)(5).

If the basis for withholding this information from public inspection should change in the
future such that the information could then be made available for public inspection, you
should promptly notify the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC). You also should
understand that the NRC may have cause to review this determination in the future, for
example, if the scope of a Freedom of Information Act request includes your information. In
all review situations, if the NRC makes a determination adverse to the above, you will be
notified in advance of any public disclosure.

Sincerely,


Adrian Muñiz, Senior Project Manager
Office of Advanced Reactors
Advanced Reactor Licensing Branch 5
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
